links.outcome: Subgroup prediction disparities and overall AUROC/AUPRC after applying case-based prompting debiasing
links.effect: AUROC rose from 0.806 to 0.873 and AUPRC from 0.497 to 0.694. Disparities fell by more than 90% in sex and certain White-Black comparisons.
links.quote: Meanwhile, prediction disparities are substantially reduced across demographic groups, with reductions exceeding 90% in sex and certain White-Black comparisons.

unlisted_practices: Case-based prompting with similar historical misprediction cases paired with correct outcomes to correct biased LLM reasoning without retraining

screen.reason: Evaluates a training-free prompt-engineering debiasing intervention (CAse Prompting) added to an LLM to mitigate demographic bias in ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV.
